chapter: First bands and the road in the South
title: Staying with Eagle Eye, then Alonzo Ross with Edmond Hall
summary: Cootie stayed with Eagle Eye for a while before moving with Hall to Alonzo Ross's band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Well, so -- well, what happened. By that time, I mean, your father, he said you could live there under his care and be in the band.
By that time you'd been in the band a little time, I guess.
Yeah. Then I stayed with the band, with Eagle Eye, for quite awhile. I don't know exactly how many years. Then I went with Alonzo Ross's band. He was from Florida, too.
And I went with Edmund Hall.
